policies.name: activity_read
policies.using: ((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.is_admin())

policies.check: ((accepted_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND private.can_read_complaint(complaint_id))
policies.name: analyses_insert

policies.check:
((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public_listings() l(id, name, location, address, description, base_rent, gender_policy, room_size, total_rooms, available_rooms, images, facilities, rules, landmarks, promoted)
  WHERE (l.id = favorites.property_id))))
policies.name: favorites_own
message_attachments_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM messages m
  WHERE ((m.id = message_attachments.message_id) AND (private.is_member(m.conversation_id) OR private.is_admin()))))

policies.name: profiles_read
policies.using: ((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.related_tenant(id) OR private.is_admin())

policies.check: ((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND private.has_role('owner'::text))
policies.name: properties_insert
tenants_read
policies.using: ((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.related_tenant(id) OR private.is_admin())

policies.name: transactions_read
policies.using:
(((kind = 'rent'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM invoices i
  WHERE ((i.id = transactions.invoice_id) AND private.can_read_agreement(i.agreement_id))))) OR ((kind = 'boost'::text) AND private.owns_property(property_id)) OR private.is_admin())

policies.name: roles_read
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.is_admin())

views.definition:
SELECT id,
    agreement_id,
    period_start,
    due_date,
    amount,
    admin_fee,
    status,
    notes,
    tenant_name_snapshot,
    property_name_snapshot,
    room_number_snapshot,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'pending'::text AND due_date < private.today() THEN 'overdue'::text
            ELSE status
        END AS effective_status
   FROM invoices i;
views.name: invoice_statuses
